method: Assistant review of the saved baseline and optimized texts against their supplied fictitious records. Not a real-world validation.
performanceTextParity: The optimized and baseline text match in all five cases.

cases.expected: The traveler can leave the backpack at reception at 11:00 because luggage is accepted from 10:00; room check-in is later.
cases.observed: The model incorrectly makes luggage storage depend on absent restaurant information and says it cannot provide an option despite mentioning the luggage time. Both variants also stop at the 96-token limit.
cases.markerCaveat: The automatic marker 10:00 is present but does not establish that the answer is useful or correct.

cases.observed: Identifies the replacement filter F-28 and cites the supplied record.
Correctly says the record does not establish authorization or the current electrical state. No actual intervention is evaluated.
Computes the 250 m elevation gain correctly, but calls the two absolute elevations desnivel instead of elevation.
Directs the user to the recorded page 42 for X17; does not invent a diagnosis.

limits: A marker match, a completed test harness, and identical text are separate from task success. These five synthetic records do not cover navigation, real equipment procedures, live conditions, or broad factual reliability.
